ideas.children_he: אֱלֹהִים הִבְטִיחַ לְאַבְרָם בְּרִית וּמִשְׁפָּחָה גְּדוֹלָה. הַבְטָחָה יְכוֹלָה לָתֵת כֹּחַ לְהַמְשִׁיךְ.
ideas.children_en: God met Abram and made a special promise to him that he will have many children and create a new order in the world.

ideas.children_he: שְׁמוֹ שֶׁל אַבְרָם הִשְׁתַּנָּה לְאַבְרָהָם. שֵׁם חָדָשׁ יָכוֹל לְסַמֵּל תַּפְקִיד חָדָשׁ וְאַחֲרָיוּת חֲדָשָׁה.
ideas.children_en: God changed Abram's name to Abraham and promised he would be the father of many nations, and the covenant will continue with all his descendants.

ideas.children_he: בְּרִית הַמִּילָה נִקְבְּעָה כְּסִימָן לַבְּרִית עִם אֱלֹהִים. לְמִשְׁפָּחוֹת וּלְעַמִּים יֵשׁ מִנְהָגִים שֶׁמְּבַטְּאִים שַׁיָּכוּת.
ideas.children_en: Every male in Abraham's family must be circumcised to keep the covenant with God, and those who don't are punished.

ideas.children_he: גַּם שָׂרַי קִבְּלָה שֵׁם חָדָשׁ, שָׂרָה, וְהַבְטָחָה לְבֵן. לִפְעָמִים תִּקְוָה חֲדָשָׁה מַגִּיעָה אַחֲרֵי הַמְתָּנָה אֲרֻכָּה.
ideas.children_en: God changed Abraham's wife's name to Sarah and promised she will have a son who will start a great and special nation.

ideas.children_he: אַבְרָהָם צָחַק כְּשֶׁשָּׁמַע שֶׁיִּוָּלֵד לוֹ בֵּן בְּגִיל מְבֻגָּר. לִפְעָמִים בְּשׂוֹרָה טוֹבָה נִשְׁמַעַת בִּלְתִּי אֶפְשָׁרִית.
ideas.children_en: Abraham laughed because he did not believe an old man and old woman could have a son, but God promised Sarah would have a son named Isaac and the covenant would continue with him.

ideas.children_he: אֱלֹהִים בֵּרַךְ גַּם אֶת יִשְׁמָעֵאל וְהִבְטִיחַ שֶׁיִּצְחָק יִוָּלֵד לְשָׂרָה. אֶפְשָׁר לִדְאֹג לְיוֹתֵר מִיֶּלֶד אֶחָד.
ideas.children_en: God heard Abraham and blessed Ishmael, but said the real covenant is with Isaac, Sarah's son who will be born in a year.

ideas.children_he: אַבְרָהָם קִיֵּם אֶת הַבְּרִית בְּאוֹתוֹ יוֹם. הַסִּפּוּר מַדְגִּישׁ אֶת הַחֲשִׁיבוּת שֶׁהוּא נָתַן לְהַבְטָחָתוֹ.
ideas.children_en: Abraham quickly obeyed God's command and circumcised himself, Ishmael, and all males in his house that same day, even though it was hard.
